# Results (generated by `scripts/make_figures.py` from `D:/IIT/Data_Science/outputs/runs/default`)

**Source: FULL run (configs/default.yaml).** 72 run files; seed 42; 1000 bootstrap resamples; main alpha 0.01. All numbers below are read from the saved run files.

## Threshold-free metrics

- Novelty AUROC (vs known): how well the novelty statistic T(x) ranks hidden-attack flows above all known-class test flows (Normal and known attacks).
- Alarm AUROC: how well the normalised Normal-class score z_Normal(x) ranks hidden-attack flows above Normal test flows, i.e. whether the flow can be told apart from Normal traffic at all, novel or not (baseline: 1 - classifier probability of Normal).

## Main table (hybrid mode, alpha = 0.01, 95% bootstrap CIs)

Hybrid mode: a flow is *unknown* if its pooled conformal p-value is <= alpha; otherwise it gets the classifier's label. Detection = unknown + wrong known attack (not labelled Normal).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | 0.0000 | 0 | 0.0000 | 0 | 0.0000 | 0 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 |
| gmm | 202.8333 | 3651 | 463.8889 | 4578 | 536.1667 | 5218 | 0.0005 | 0.0099 | 0.0047 | 0.0451 | 0.0086 | 0.0784 |
| knn | 433.0556 | 3915 | 514.9444 | 4649 | 614.3333 | 5557 | 0.0010 | 0.0103 | 0.0048 | 0.0437 | 0.0095 | 0.0864 |
| pca | 0.0000 | 0 | 0.0000 | 0 | 2.5556 | 46 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 0.0072 | 0.1304 |

**Resolution limit.** A conformal p-value can never be smaller than P_min = 1 / (n_final + 1). BH rejects the k smallest p-values only if p_(k) <= k q / m, so with the smallest p-values sitting at P_min, BH can reject only when at least about P_min * m / q test flows share that floor (m = number of test flows). The table gives, for each round, n_final, m, P_min, how many test flows are at the floor, and how many would be needed at each q. The floor count is a guide, not an exact condition: BH can also reject when the smallest p-values are just above the floor, as long as p_(k) <= k q / m holds (compare the 'flagged' and 'at floor' columns).
